usedFor: Productlane holds contacts and companies, and Google Contacts stores each one through “Create Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Contact” in Productlane, then “Create Contact” in Google Contacts
bestTemplate.why: A new contact in Productlane gets its own Google Contacts entry, so your address book stays current.

watchOut: “Update Contact” in Google Contacts merges new details with existing fields, so it suits repeat people better than “Create Contact”.
